title: Texas Hold'em
subtitle: Monte Carlo Hand Evaluation
overview: The world's most popular poker variant. Players combine two private cards with five community cards to make the best five-card hand.
rules: Make the best 5-card hand from any 7 cards
Betting rounds: Preflop, Flop, Turn, River
Hand rankings from Royal Flush to High Card

algorithm.name: Monte Carlo Simulation
algorithm.description: The AI estimates hand strength by simulating thousands of possible outcomes, calculating win probability against random opponent hands.

proof.explanation: Poker has an enormous state space due to hidden information and betting history.
proof.formula: States ≈ C(52,2) x C(50,2) x C(48,5) x (betting histories) ≈ 10^18
steps: Betting sequences: Exponential in game length
proof.conclusion: This massive state space makes poker intractable to solve exactly.

proof.explanation: Total unique 5-card poker hands from a standard 52-card deck.
proof.conclusion: Most hands (92%) are one pair or worse.

proof.explanation: Monte Carlo precision improves with square root of sample size (CLT).
steps: Each simulation: Win(1), Lose(0), or Tie(0.5)
proof.conclusion: 1000 simulations provide sufficient accuracy for most decisions.

keyInsight: Call when your win probability exceeds the ratio of call amount to total pot.
